newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle shares fall on disappointing Q1.
newsitem.headline: Nestle shares fall on disappointing Q1.

text.p: Shares in Swiss food and beverage group Nestle SA eased on the Swiss Exchange following first quarter sales figures that were slightly lower than expected.

At 0820 GMT Nestle's registered shares were down 16 francs at 1,826 francs on the day. Before the results were announced, Nestle's share was trading at 1,840 francs for a net loss of 14 francs or 0.8 percent after the result.
Nestle's sales rose 18.7 percent to 16.1 billion francs in the first quarter, but the market had generally been looking for a rise of around 20 percent, dealers said.
